meta.title: Digital Forensics Analyst
meta.tagline: Investigate cyber incidents through digital evidence analysis.
meta.description: Digital forensics analysts collect, preserve and analyze digital evidence from computers, networks and mobile devices. They follow strict chain-of-custody procedures and use specialized tools to reconstruct events for incident response or legal proceedings.
